title: Marigold retrieval labels
description: Ground truth for Recall@k in scripts/eval_rag.py. Keys under `documents` are PDF filenames in eval/docs/. A label whose query is empty or whose answer_pages is empty is treated as unfilled and skipped.

query.description: A topic ("light-dependent reactions") or a question ("Where does the Calvin cycle happen?"), embedded and searched exactly as generation searches.

answer_pages.description: 1-based page number(s) where the answer appears. A retrieval is a hit if any of the top-k chunks spans any of these pages.
